## Professional Focus

Jayhind builds reliable backend-focused business systems using Node.js, JavaScript, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Docker, REST APIs, webhooks, CRM workflows, real-time calling systems, production-ready backend services, and AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, ECS, ECR, API Gateway, Lambda, SES, and SNS.
